description: An 18% tip on $84 is $15.12 – $49.56 each for two. Tip on the pre-tax amount, net off a service charge already on the bill and round each share up. Web page: https://calcbright.com/tip-calculator

bill.description: Bill amount (the total printed on the bill)

service.description: Service charge already on the bill (%) As a percentage of the food and drink subtotal – e.g. 10 at a Dubai hotel restaurant, 12.5 in many London restaurants.

tax.description: Sales tax / VAT included in the bill (%) e.g. 5 for UAE VAT, 15 for Saudi VAT, 8.875 for New York City sales tax. 0 if the bill has no tax.

tip.description: Tip percentage (%) The total gratuity you want to give. A service charge already on the bill counts towards it.
